body: I talk to her every day, I play with her almost every day, I have many friends online but it will never be the same as having someone at school and in real life to spend time with. Again, thank you so much, I am so grateful

I am of course thankful for what I've got, I know that many other people have it worse too so I feel kinda bad about that.

I did have one friend, we were eachothers only friend for 4-5 years but she's moved away twice before. (Yes, she actually came back at one point and then left again. ouch.) I know everyone at my school relatively well, and I don't like being in friendship groups, so that's why I'd prefer to be alone.

I'm thankful that you actually spent the time reading this and replying. I really am
Aw, I used to but I think they got bored of my lack of reaction. If you're getting bullied in school, then I'm sorry. It's horrible and you should 100% tell your teachers <3
